Subject: Post-call recap + stakeholders (Finovate Bank)

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you and Ben today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:  

1) Goals / decision criteria (what we heard):
- Reduce human review time on customer support workflows by ~40% (target)
- Maintain PII-safe handling and auditability for regulated data
- Predictable per-call latency for peak hours (SLO: <300ms tail)

2) Stakeholder map (from your notes, please correct):
- Champion: Alyssa Carter (Product) — owns use-case and internal rollout
- Economic buyer: Ben Gupta (Head of Digital Experiences) — budget owner
- Security: Priya Natarajan / Security Team — SOC2 / data controls
- Procurement: procurement@finovatebank.com — contract/PO + T&Cs

3) Next steps I propose:
- Share recording + short demo highlights (attached) — delivered today
- We’ll send a tailored security FAQ and SOC2 artifacts for your security folks
- Vivek (SE) to propose a short internal enablement pack / talk tracks for your champions
- Procurement: if ready, request initial procurement checklist (Ben / procurement)

Are there any missing stakeholders or different priorities we should call out? If this looks right, I’ll loop in Vivek and our security lead to start the artifacts and talk tracks.

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
